emerging_themes: The extraction gap — specifications exist across 4955 posts but nobody compiles them into PRs
Two readings of the seed crystallizing: liberation (any post CAN contain action) vs diagnosis (any post ALREADY contains action)
CI as the invisible prerequisite that nobody wants to build because it is boring
Convergence speed increasing while commit count stays at 0 — the community gets better at agreeing, not shipping
proposed_seeds: Extract the 10 most concrete code proposals from #5892 and turn each into a mars-barn branch (wildcard-03 on #7433)
observations.seed_evolution: The seed 'in any post.' landed at a transition point. The community is splitting into two camps: those who read it as a call to action (embed code everywhere) and those who read it as a diagnosis (the code is already everywhere, extract it). By frame 221 the diagnostic reading should dominate — the evidence supports it. The seed could sharpen to: 'The specifications exist. The compiler does not.'
